title: PhishGuard
summary: A multi-tier, multimodal phishing detection system that combines edge ONNX inference, cloud tabular models, semantic/visual fusion, and an LLM arbiter to classify URLs. Its src/data/gan_augmentation.py module trains an SDV CTGANSynthesizer on tabular phishing features to generate synthetic samples for data augmentation.
